title: Velvet Clause Runner
text: Velvet Clause Runner races between market stalls enforcing the smallest print with a concealed hook. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.

defeatReward.text: Velvet Clause Runner is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
